summary: Russian forces launched multiple drone and missile attacks across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure and urban centers. A missile strike in Kyiv damaged the 'Epichern' shopping center, killing one person and injuring 22, including four children. New Russian 'Filin' cruise missiles with 1,200km range pose a significant threat to Ukraine's entire territory.
key_points: Russian missile strike in Kyiv's Oboronivskyi district damaged the 'Epichern' shopping center, killing one person and injuring 22, including four children (Source: @eRadarrua/125513).
Multiple Geran-5 and reactive drones attacked Kyiv, Dnipro, Kharkiv, and other regions, with reports of explosions and damage (Source: @mon1tor_ua/77408).
Russian forces attacked energy infrastructure in three regions, causing power outages in six areas (Source: @UkraineNow/84835).
Ukrainian drones attacked the '75th Arsenal' facility in Serpukhov, Moscow region, where missile systems are stored and repaired (Source: @UkraineNow/84832).
New Russian 'Filin' cruise missile has 1,200km range, enabling strikes across all of Ukraine from Russian territory (Source: @eRadarrua/125516).
Russian attacks on energy infrastructure continue, with reports of power outages in six areas following strikes on three regions (Source: @UkraineNow/84835).
Ukrainian forces are negotiating with the US and Russia on technical-level peace talks, with 'good news' expected soon (Source: @UkraineNow/84825).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces are escalating attacks across Ukraine, targeting energy infrastructure and urban centers with drones, missiles, and cruise missiles. The introduction of the 'Filin' cruise missile with 1,200km range significantly expands Russia's strike capability, threatening Ukraine's entire territory. Ukrainian infrastructure and civilian areas are under sustained attack, with potential for increased casualties and humanitarian crisis.
sections.regional_response: International negotiations continue at the technical level between the US, Russia, and Ukraine, with 'good news' expected soon. NATO is facilitating Ukrainian arms purchases through the NATO Support Agency, improving procurement efficiency. Poland's foreign ministry criticized Ukraine's regional decision to commemorate Roman Shukhevych, calling it 'counterproductive' for bilateral relations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian forces are employing a mix of Geran-5 and reactive drones, alongside cruise missiles, to target Ukrainian infrastructure and urban centers. The 'Filin' missile's 1,200km range represents a strategic escalation, enabling strikes from Russian territory across all of Ukraine. Ukrainian drone operations against Russian military facilities indicate continued offensive capabilities despite defensive posture.
